adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is explicitly expanded for COLLECTIVE team events (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`), making the in-memory `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` potentially contain multiple calendars. However, when persisting the Booking, the diff connects only `evt.destinationCalendar[0]` via `connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }` (around the shown hunk near line ~1871), discarding the rest. Later handlers in this diff (confirm/cancel/editLocation/deleteCredential/webhooks/etc.) rebuild `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` from `booking.destinationCalendar` (singular) and wrap it as a 1-element array, so any subsequent operation that relies on the booking record (e.g., confirmation flow for a pending COLLECTIVE booking) cannot recover the full list of destination calendars added at creation time.
